newsitem.title: USA: No damaging cold this week for Brazil coffee - WSC.
newsitem.headline: No damaging cold this week for Brazil coffee - WSC.

text.p: Somewhat cooler than normal conditions are expected in Brazil's coffee belt this week, but no damaging cold is indicated and there are no cold airmasses forecast to build out of Argentina, independent forecaster Weather Services Corp said on Tuesday.
Conditions for the trees and the maturing crop are generally favourable at this time.

Variable cloud is forecast for Central Brazil on Tuesday, with isolated to widely scattered showers of 0.10-0.50 inch and 20-30 percent coverage, WSC said. Highs will be 66-83 F and lows on Tuesday night 50-64 F.

Wednesday will be mostly cloudy with episodes of scattered showers and thunderstorms of 0.25-0.75 inch and highs of 67-82 F. Thursday will be cool with showers and thunderstorms, Friday will be clearing and cool, and Saturday fair and cool.
There were showers through Minas Gerais on Monday but dry weather elsewhere. Rainfall totalled 0.12-0.43 inch with 20 percent coverage, while highs were 64-86 F.
